title: Quasistatic Cavity Resonance for Ubiquitous Wireless Power Transfer
summary: Disney Research's demo of quasistatic cavity resonance, which uses a purpose-built room or cabinet to generate magnetic fields that deliver kilowatts of power wirelessly to mobile receivers inside.
why: HN cites it as an example of early research into room-scale wireless power transfer.

quote.text: There is already early-stage research into long-range wireless charging
